aboutPage.meta.description: HatchGrab builds practical software for food trucks and mobile catering: online orders, collection times and fewer repetitive questions. Founded by Dominic Bonini.
aboutPage.meta.title: About us — HatchGrab
aboutPage.story.build: We build practical software specifically for food trucks and mobile catering, helping them take online orders, manage collection times, keep orders flowing smoothly and spend less time dealing with repetitive questions.
aboutPage.story.change: HatchGrab was created to change that.
aboutPage.story.fixedAddress: Yet much of the software available to them is designed around businesses with a fixed address.
aboutPage.story.focus: Our focus is simple: make running a food truck easier, with tools designed around how these businesses actually operate.
aboutPage.story.start: HatchGrab started with a simple observation: food trucks need better tools to run their businesses.
aboutPage.story.villageFoodie: After creating Village Foodie, a directory helping people discover food trucks visiting their local area, I spent more time learning about the challenges mobile food businesses face. Unlike traditional restaurants, food trucks are constantly moving, working at different locations and serving customers in changing conditions.

landing.does.capacityBody: Set how much you can cook at once and how long it takes. When a collection time is full, customers can no longer choose it.
landing.does.devicesBody: Works on the phone in your apron pocket, the tablet on the counter, the laptop in the food truck — and the card terminal you already take payments with.
landing.does.lede: Most ordering systems assume a fixed address, reliable wifi and the same opening hours every week. You are somewhere new every week, at different times, with weak mobile coverage or none at all. HatchGrab was built just for that.
landing.does.offlineBody: If you lose signal, online ordering pauses automatically so customers cannot place orders you won’t see. Keep taking orders with the iPhone, iPad and Android app.
landing.does.postsBody: Upload the design you already post on Facebook or Instagram. We add your dates, places and times, ready to share — every week or every day.
landing.does.postsTitle: Automate your Facebook and Instagram posts
landing.does.slotsBody: Customers order ahead and choose a collection time. Fewer queues, and the food is ready when they arrive.
landing.does.title: Built for food trucks, not restaurants.
landing.does.whatsappBody: “Where are you tonight?” “What desserts do you have?” Your WhatsApp messages get answered while you drive to the pitch or stand at the grill — based on your own menu and schedule. Messenger and Instagram are coming.
landing.does.whatsappSoonBody: “Where are you tonight?” “What desserts do you have?” Soon your WhatsApp messages will be answered while you drive to the pitch or stand at the grill. Messenger and Instagram will follow.
landing.final.lede: Upload a photo or screenshot of your menu and in under 60 seconds we turn it into a working ordering page you can try out yourself. Your items, your prices. No registration, no bank card, nothing to install. Have a look and then decide.
